content.value_statement: Backend services become inconsistent when agents mix routes, controllers, config, validation, and database access patterns. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured rules for maintainable Node.js APIs.
actual_capabilities: Defines layered routes, controllers, services, and repositories for Express applications.
Provides BaseController patterns for responses, errors, Sentry, and validation.
Shows configuration practices using unifiedConfig and environment-specific settings.
Guides Prisma repository usage, transactions, caching, and data access tests.
Covers Zod validation, middleware design, async errors, and Jest testing.
limitations: It is guidance, not an executable framework or code generator.
Examples assume Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Prisma, Sentry, Zod, and Jest.
Project-specific paths and service names may need adjustment.
It does not replace security review for production code.

use_cases.title: Standardize API Feature Work
use_cases.description: Apply consistent route, controller, service, and repository boundaries when adding backend features.

use_cases.title: Guide AI Code Reviews
use_cases.description: Ask an assistant to compare backend changes against local architecture, validation, and error handling rules.

use_cases.title: Refactor Legacy Routes
use_cases.description: Move business logic out of Express routes into controllers, services, and repositories.

prompt_templates.title: Review API Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backend-dev-guidelines to review this endpoint design. Identify route, controller, service, repository, validation, config, and testing gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Add an Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backend-dev-guidelines to plan a new Express endpoint. Include controller responsibilities, service logic, repository needs, validation, errors, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Route Logic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backend-dev-guidelines to refactor this route. Move business logic into service methods and keep the route limited to middleware and delegation.

prompt_templates.title: Design Service Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backend-dev-guidelines to design a microservice module. Specify layers, naming, dependency injection, configuration, monitoring, validation, and test coverage.

output_examples.input: Review a new user endpoint for architecture issues.
output: Flags business logic inside the route handler.
Recommends controller delegation and a service method for user creation.
Adds Zod validation and focused unit tests.

output_examples.input: Plan a repository-backed feature for posts.
output: Defines route, controller, service, repository, and validator responsibilities.
Identifies Prisma operations and transaction boundaries.
Lists Jest and integration tests for main success and error paths.

output_examples.input: Improve configuration handling in an Express service.
output: Moves scattered environment reads behind typed configuration access.
Adds startup validation for required settings.
Keeps production secrets outside committed files.

best_practices: Use controllers for HTTP concerns and services for business rules.
Validate input with Zod before service calls.
Centralize configuration and secrets behind typed config objects.
anti_patterns: Placing database calls and permission checks directly in route handlers.
Reading environment variables throughout application code.
Logging sensitive request data or secrets to monitoring tools.

faq.question: Which stack does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Prisma, Sentry, Zod, and Jest backend services.

faq.question: Can it generate complete services?
faq.answer: It provides architecture guidance and examples. The assistant still needs project context to write final code.

faq.question: Does it include testing guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers unit tests, integration tests, mocking, test data setup, and coverage targets.

faq.question: Does it support configuration management?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends typed centralized configuration and warns against scattered environment variable access.

faq.question: Is it useful for code review?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives review criteria for layering, validation, error handling, monitoring, and data access boundaries.

faq.question: Does it run commands or access services?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation. Any command examples require normal user-controlled execution by the assistant.
